notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hey golfers!

It's time for another update! Just before Christmas, we have a bag full of exciting new features for you. Let's dive right in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27663206/07d1f276e6a0e29baf732ab8491009a5ecf580b5.png

Audio Overhaul

After seven years on the market, we finally realized that there were absolutely no sounds in the game. So we decided to dub the whole thing, figuring it was better late than never. Now you can hear everything - the sound of your golf ball rolling on different surfaces, hitting things, the sound of the environment, the user interface, and much more. It is a completely new, immersive journey to play our official maps. Not only that, but all the sounds are also available in our map editor. We can't wait to hear what you're going to create.

Grassland Visual Upgrade

Our oldest and most iconic map is Grassland. It was created as part of our Steam Greenlight prototype and hasn't gotten much love since. That's why we've created over 150 new assets to make this map more visually appealing. Of course, all of these assets are also available to you in our editor.

https://i.imgur.com/Ieez2eT.gif

Challenge System

Sometimes a game against friends is not enough of a challenge. For those times, we've created an all-new challenge system. It will provide you with new challenges of varying difficulty every day. Completing these tasks will reward you with coins and items that are sometimes only available there. In our new shop, you can spend your hard-earned coins on skins, trails, hats and more.

https://i.imgur.com/Jr1c4Eq.gif

Additional Swing Mechanic

Staring at the same putter for over seven years gets pretty boring. That's why we've added a new type of equipable item - the putter. They are pretty rare, but be sure to check out your first Weekly Challenge, you just might be able to find one. To help you get even more enjoyment out of your brand new putter, we've decided to add a new, optional visual swing style. It's more like a swing and less like a train. Check our options and activate the rotational swing, but be careful, you might lose your skill.

https://i.imgur.com/YXxB4En.gif

Have fun and take care,

Team Perfuse Entertainment

After months of work we are close to release our first VR build. Something many of you requested since we have launched our greenlight campaign. And there is even more new stuff going to be included in Update 0.8.0. This update is all about preparation.

Engine Update
In order to deliver a better VR experience we had to update the version of our game engine. This time the update was awful, since it had a huge impact on the physical behavior of our game. To guarantee that every custom map still works as intended - which is our top priority - we had to put a lot of effort into this process.

So what is this update about?
This “pre” update is all about quality assurance. After days of testing, we are confident that everything runs smoothly. The only uncertainty is the behavior of your setup. That is why this update only contains the engine update and the following improvements:


Significant collision improvements
More consistent shooting behavior
Scoreboard additions
Spectator fixes
Much faster update cycle

What if it’s broken?
If you encounter something broken, please tell us. The best way is to enter our Discord: https://discord.gg/perfuse
If things are terribly broken, you can switch to our legacy branch. This can be done by right-clicking “Golf It!” in your Steam Library > Properties. Click on “Betas” and change the “NONE” branch to “legacy”.

Gravitationzones

A feature we've eagerly awaited since release is to change the gravitation based on zones.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/95ca86fd90233a72052562f28dadee1d5df9ef17.gif

We're providing two different gravitation zones - a sphere and a cube. The cube will set the gravitation into a given direction. The sphere will set the gravitation in its center. If you set the gravity to 0 you will be in zero G and able to shoot in all directions.

Custom Music and Sounds

We know you are utterly in love with our music - especially on graveyard. But in case you wanna create a specific mood on your custom map you can now import your own ogg music. You can use our eventsystem to change the music to whatever you want.

Eventsystem Enhancement

We're really happy about the success of our eventsystem. There are already tons of use cases uploaded to the Workshop, which show us your inexhaustible creativity. Our goal is to restrict it as little as possible, therefore we are constantly extending the eventsystem.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/8db902022c57f8d8da7938cbac03e11629d87ea2.gif

With this update the eventsystem gains control over some interesting map settings, for instance a dynamic day and night cycle. Besides the time of day you can change the theme of an asset, the background music or even the gravity. 

Our Discord

We've created a Discord Server long time ago, but didn't tell anybody. Now is the time we are going to change that: https://discord.gg/TQqpYgR

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/9a62a1d01778d27f76d21047dbb37434ad3ee21e.gif

The Eventsystem allows to create more dynamic maps than ever before. When a player enters or leaves an event zone dozens of actions can get triggered, which will affect lanes, meshes, rotators, lights, boosts, teleporter and so on. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27663206/963456e416d097afdf1979426066689166c698b5.gif

We are more than excited to see your dynamic map creations.

Game Refactoring

One of our major concerns is to optimize features which are already in place. This time we've completely redesigned our golf ball mechanics, to make our gameplay more smooth and pleasant, but still being as skilled-based as before.

Another complete overhaul happend to our particle system, which means that we have heavily improved every single trail. So you may need to test every trail again to redefine your favorite one.

YuNO for intensely testing our latest features and thereby pushing the quality of our game.
